answer: Hardware enclave attestation mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to present cryptographic proofs signed by secure processor silicon. To stem the tide of synthetic bots, a validator grove verifies each signature against manufacturer root certificates. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of procuring physical enclave chips for each identity. A key limitation is that side-channel exploits can leak private keys, letting forged identities persist like hardy yarrow despite revocations.
